resources.name: Omron Management
resources.description: Backend API for the Omron weight control system. See backend/AGENTS.md for the architecture and docs/schema.dbml for the data model.

resources.name: Skinfold Protocols
resources.description: CRUD for the SkinfoldProtocol reference table (e.g. Jackson-Pollock 3, Jackson-Pollock 7, Durnin-Womersley). All endpoints require auth:sanctum (Bearer token). Set the `token` env var to a Sanctum-issued personal access token. Authz: viewAny/view are open to any authenticated user (reference data is read often from forms); create/update require admin/super-admin; delete requires super-admin only.

resources.name: List Skinfold Protocols
resources.description: GET /api/skinfold-protocols — paginated list with filters. Query params (all optional): per_page (int 1..100, default 25), page (int >=1, default 1), name (string, ilike %term%), sites_count (int 1..50, exact match). Results are ordered by `sites_count` ASC then `name` ASC (reference data, not by date). Filters AND together. Open to any authenticated user.

resources.name: Create Skinfold Protocol
resources.description: POST /api/skinfold-protocols — body fields: name (string, required, max 255, must be unique), sites_count (int, required, 1..50), description (string, optional, nullable). Returns 422 on duplicate name or validation failure. Requires `create` policy (admin/super-admin).

resources.name: Show Skinfold Protocol
resources.description: GET /api/skinfold-protocols/{skinfold_protocol} — returns the protocol. Path: set `skinfold_protocol_id` env var or replace `{skinfold_protocol_id}` in the URL. Soft-deleted protocols return 404. Open to any authenticated user.

resources.name: Update Skinfold Protocol
resources.description: PUT/PATCH /api/skinfold-protocols/{skinfold_protocol} — all body fields optional (`sometimes`). On name change, the unique check excludes the current protocol (so you can re-send the same name without conflict). Soft-deleted protocols return 404. Requires `update` policy (admin/super-admin).

resources.name: Delete Skinfold Protocol
resources.description: DELETE /api/skinfold-protocols/{skinfold_protocol} — soft delete (sets `deleted_at`). The protocol stays in the DB but is hidden by the SoftDeletes global scope. WARNING: this resource is referenced by `skinfold_measurements.skinfold_protocol_id` with `restrictOnDelete`; soft delete is safe, but a hard delete (forceDelete in tinker) will fail. Requires `delete` policy (super-admin only — admins are denied).
